gloss: to rush to; to hurry to the scene

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {駆|か}けつけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to rush to; to hurry to; to come running
definitions.explanation: To hurry to a place upon hearing news, often in response to an emergency, event, or summons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}けつけた。
examples.english: The ambulance rushed to the scene immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}けつけた。
examples.english: I rushed to the hospital after hearing the news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧がした⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{次|つぎ}々⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{駆|か}けつけてきた。
examples.english: There was a loud noise, so the neighbors came rushing over one after another.

notes:
{駆|か}けつける is an intransitive ichidan verb. A compound of ⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧ (to run/dash) and ⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to arrive at).

ASPECT (ている):
Rarely used in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form. The focus is on the act of rushing to a place.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [place]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}けつける — to rush to [place]

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}けつける (rush to the scene)
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}けつける (rush to the hospital)
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}けつける (rush to give support)

Implies urgency and physical movement. Often used when someone responds quickly to an emergency or important event.
